name: session-autoname
description: Auto-names background agent sessions from what they are actually working on, refreshed at the end of every turn by a cheap Haiku call.

interface.shortDescription: Background agent sessions name themselves from what they are doing.
interface.longDescription: Installs a machine-level Stop hook that renames each background Claude Code agent session after every turn, using a cheap Haiku call over the session's opening request and its latest activity. Keeps the job list readable when a long session drifts away from the task it started on.
defaultPrompt: Set up the session autonamer on this machine
Stop my background sessions keeping stale names
